# ThreadVisibility

Which agents bound to a loom may see a thread.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Shared"` | Recalled by any agent bound to the loom. |
| `"Private"` | A note the authoring agent keeps for itself; never surfaced to another agent sharing the loom. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)
